main_text.p: Ithpeh אִשְׁתָּדִי Abjici, projici, ejici: Fundi, effundi: moveri, commoveri, agitari, agitare, commovere se: volare, volitare, advolare, evolare; Ex Aphel Partic. וּמַשְׁדֵּי עַפְרָא Et projiciebat, spargebat pulverem, 2. Sam. 16. 13.
Syr. Jaculator, spiculator: Pl. Et jaculatores, spiculatores à dextera, Act. 23. 23. Gr. δεξιολάβος, Satellites, stipatores.
Syriac. Jactus, Quasi jactum lapidis, Lucæ 22. 41.
שְׁרִיוֹת Chald. Effusio, profusio, Genes. 49. 12. & Num. 35. 25. 33. in Jon.
* Syr. Ethpah. Promisit, spopondit, pollicitus est. Ex cum prothesi
Syr. Promissio, pactum. Plur. In promissionibus, ad Hebr. 8. 6.
שֵׁידָא Ch. Syr. Dæmon, Satan, Hebr. שֵׁד, à שֵׁדָא Vastavit, devastavit, 1 Plural. שֵׁדִין, שֵׁרִין Dæmones.
שְׁרֵי Chald. Præpotens, omnipotens, unum ex nominibus Dei, à potentia ejus desumptum. Vide Lexica Hebraica.
main_text.head: שָׁרַךְ
main_text.p: Ch. Quievit, requievit, quietus, tranquillus fuit. Pahel שָׁרֵךְ Quiescere fecit, quietem præstitit, tranquillum reddidit, seda vit, placavit, Psal. 90. 11. & 94. 13. Ithpeh. כַּר אִשְׁתָּרֵךְ Cùm sedatus esset, Esth. 2. 1.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac, Chaldee and Greek words are reproduced approximately; the Syriac forms and vowel points are partly illegible in the scan. "Cùm se[d]atus" is partly obscured by a fold. Some Psalm and Esther references are uncertain.
